Maximum number of sets that can be made will be HCF of number of books and number of notebook to be distributed.

If the length of the diagonal of a rectangle and half its perimeter are 11 cm and 13 cm respectively, what is its area?

A. 12 square cm

B. 48 square cm

C. 36 square cm

D. 24 square cm
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of diagonal of rectangle = 11 cm

Half of perimeter = 13 cm

**Formula used:**

(i) Area of rectangle = l × b

(ii) Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

(iii) Diagonal of rectangle = √(l2 + b2)

where,

l = length of rectangle

b = breadth of rectangle

(iv) (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

**Calculations:**

Diagonal = √(l² + b²)

⇒ 11 = √(l2 + b2)

⇒ l2 + b2 = 121 ----(i)

Perimeter = 2(l + b)

Half of perimeter = 2(l + b)/2

⇒ 2(l + b)/2 = 13

⇒ l + b = 13 ----(ii)

On squaring both sides,

⇒ (l + b)² = (13)²

⇒ l2 + b2 + 2lb = 169

⇒ 121 + 2lb = 169

⇒ 2lb = 169 - 121

⇒ 2lb = 48

⇒ lb = 24 square cm

**∴ The area is 24 square cm.**

questions.question:
If 5 men can do a work in 9 days, then in how many days will 3 men finish the same work?

A. 12

B.15

C. 13

D. 18
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 men can do work in 9 days

**Concept used:**

If n person can do work in x days, then 1 person can do the work in (n × x) days.

**Calculation:**

5 men can do work in 9 days

⇒ 1 man can do the same work in 9 × 5 = 45 days

3 men can do the same work in 45/3 days

**∴ 3 men can do the work in 15 days**
